services.name: Ticket
services.desc: All visitors with public assistance cards are eligible for free admission for up to 5 people per card. Valid public assistance IDs include: WIC, EBT, SNAP, Medicaid, ProviderOne/Apple Health, or Registered Foster Family identification. Tickets to the National Nordic Museum range from $10-25, with the lowest price available when you purchase your ticket online. Walk-ins are always welcome, but we encourage you to purchase your ticket ahead of time to save time and money on the day of your visit. services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Dive deeper into Nordic culture, art, and history with a guided tour led by our knowledgeable docents! We offer drop-in tours every Friday, included with Museum admission. Tours meet outside of Osberg Great Hall, near the entrance to the Museum. Space is limited to 15 guests on a first-come, first-served basis. Discounted rates are available for groups of 8 or more. Tours are available by reservation only and must be booked at least two weeks in advance to ensure availability.
